summary: "Massive Update for Microsoft Stock Investors! | MSFT Stock Analysis," published 7 Oct 2026, is Parkevtate Vosianc's re-assessment of Microsoft after he downgraded it from his earlier high-conviction BUY (entered below $400, reiterated at $350, last BUY call 21 Aug). The call: MSFT — HOLD @ ~$525, reiterating the HOLD stance from 1 Oct with no flip vs the tracked record. He bought for his own portfolio in the crash and rode it to ~$525; his DCF fair value of ~$406 implies the stock is overvalued ~30% on fundamentals, though the forward PE of ~22 still looks fine against his 30 threshold. His posture: not selling, not adding above $500 until fundamentals step up — a long-term holder's position. Bull case: ~$65B estimated 2026 FCF, revenue up 18% with 2% fewer staff, Copilot at 30M paid seats with seat adds doubling quarter-over-quarter. Bear case: ROIC trending down (33% in 2022 to ~26%), slowest hyperscaler revenue growth at 18%, ~$41B capex with two-thirds on short-lived GPUs/CPUs, and 2027 FCF dipping as AI investment ramps. No other tickers discussed.
